criteria.reason: The exercise menu includes a “Skip Exercise” option during log mode.
Selecting it opens a confirmation dialog before applying the skip.
Skipping sends every set with status "skipped" and the server stores that status.
The card displays “Skipped” when all sets are skipped, and mixed skipped sets are treated as partial.
The menu offers “Unskip Exercise” during the same session.
The existing sets endpoint handles the skip status.
No new server test for skip or unskip appears in the diff.
No new client test for the skip UI appears in the diff.
The harness reports all existing server and client tests passing.
The UI copy is direct and contains no exclamation marks.
